system.description:
You extract water from an area near a willing creature you can see within range creating a medium sized shield of water to protect them. The target increases their AC by +1, and gains +4 DR. If this jutsu would reduce Fire damage you instead double the DR granted by this jutsu.

If used near a sufficient source of water, reduce the chakra cost of this jutsu by 2 or you can select +1 additional creature to gain this jutsu’s benefits.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu Is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the AC bonus by +1 and the DR by +2. If this jutsu is cast a B-Rank, the creature gaining the benefit of this jutsu can choose to end this jutsu’s effect early on them when they take damage, but in exchange, gaining resistance to the triggering damage type. If this jutsu Is cast at A-Rank, increase the AC bonus by +2 and the DR by +4. If this jutsu Is cast at S-Rank, this jutsu instead affects all willing creatures of your choice within a 30-foot radius sphere.
